title: Generative Replay for Equilibrium Propagation: Toward Edge-Friendly Continual Learning in Hopfield Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.37139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Equilibrium Propagation (EqProp) offers a biologically grounded and hardware-aligned alternative to backpropagation for training Hopfield Networks. However, its behavior in continual learning settings remains largely unexplored. This work confronts catastrophic forgetting in EqProp-trained Hopfield Networks from the inside out, eliminating the need for external data buffers or architectural overhead that standard Experience Replay \textbf{(ER)} and Generative Replay \textbf{(Gen-Replay)} inevitably require. We introduce an Energy-Based Generative Replay strategy \textbf{(EB-Gen)} which exploits the intrinsic generative dynamics of Hopfield Networks, allowing a single model to act as both classifier and replay samples generator. Samples capturing past task knowledge are generated by relaxing a frozen copy of the network, enabling rehearsal solely through internally generated pseudo-data. We evaluate the proposed method in the Class-Incr

translated_title: 面向平衡传播的生成式回放：迈向霍普菲尔德网络中边缘友好的持续学习
translated_abstract: 平衡传播为训练霍普菲尔德网络提供了一种具有生物学基础且与硬件契合的反向传播替代方案。然而，其在持续学习场景中的表现仍在很大程度上未被探索。本工作从内到外地应对了用平衡传播训练的霍普菲尔德网络中的灾难性遗忘问题，消除了标准经验回放（Experience Replay, ER）和生成式回放（Generative Replay, Gen-Replay）不可避免需要的外部数据缓冲区或架构开销。我们提出了一种基于能量的生成式回放策略（Energy-Based Generative Replay, EB-Gen），该策略利用霍普菲尔德网络的内在生成动力学，使单一模型既能充当分类器又能充当回放样本生成器。通过松弛网络的一个冻结副本，即可生成承载过去任务知识的样本，从而仅依靠内部生成的伪数据就能完成复习。我们在类增量（Class-Incr……）设置中对该方法进行了评估（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出基于能量的生成式回放策略EB-Gen，利用霍普菲尔德网络自身的生成动力学，让单一网络既当分类器又当样本生成器，通过松弛冻结的网络副本来生成过去任务的伪样本，从而无需外部数据缓冲即可解决平衡传播训练中的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an Energy-Based Generative Replay (EB-Gen) strategy that exploits the intrinsic generative dynamics of Hopfield Networks, allowing a single model to act as both classifier and replay sample generator by relaxing a frozen copy of the network, thereby mitigating catastrophic forgetting in Equilibrium Propagation-trained Hopfield Networks without external data buffers.
